source: ## Ekstraksi ZIP dan partisi

import glob
import json
import os
import shutil
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

storage = "adls1tcba"
container = "lakehouse"

kaggle_json_abfss = (
    f"abfss://{container}@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/config/kaggle.json"
)
bronze_root = (
    f"abfss://{container}@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/tomtom_partitioned"
)
temp_dir_abfss = (
    f"abfss://{container}@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/temp_extracted_csv"
)

local_kaggle_dir = "/tmp/.kaggle"
local_download_dir = "/tmp/kaggle_tomtom"

# 1. Ambil kredensial kaggle.json dari ADLS ke /tmp/.kaggle
os.makedirs(local_kaggle_dir, exist_ok=True)
mssparkutils.fs.cp(kaggle_json_abfss, f"file:{local_kaggle_dir}/kaggle.json")
os.chmod(f"{local_kaggle_dir}/kaggle.json", 0o600)

with open(f"{local_kaggle_dir}/kaggle.json", "r") as f:
  creds = json.load(f)

os.environ["KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR"] = local_kaggle_dir
os.environ["KAGGLE_USERNAME"] = creds["username"]
os.environ["KAGGLE_KEY"] = creds["key"]

# 2. Download & ekstrak dataset dari Kaggle
import kaggle

dataset_slug = "bwandowando/tomtom-traffic-data-55-countries-387-cities"
os.makedirs(local_download_dir, exist_ok=True)

kaggle.api.authenticate()
kaggle.api.dataset_download_files(
    dataset_slug, path=local_download_dir, unzip=True
)

# Cari spesifik file/folder yang mengandung kata 'NewApi' (abaikan ForExport lama)
matches = glob.glob(
    os.path.join(local_download_dir, "**", "*NewApi*"), recursive=True
)
if not matches:
  raise FileNotFoundError(
      f"NewApi tidak ditemukan di {os.listdir(local_download_dir)}"
  )

# Jika hasil unzip berupa folder bernama ForExportNewApi.csv, ambil file CSV di dalamnya; jika langsung file, pakai langsung
selected_path = matches[0]
if os.path.isdir(selected_path):
  inner_files = [
      os.path.join(selected_path, f)
      for f in os.listdir(selected_path)
      if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(selected_path, f))
  ]
  selected_csv = inner_files[0]
else:
  selected_csv = selected_path

print("File CSV final yang disalin:", selected_csv)

# 3. Pindahkan ke ADLS sementara (pakai recurse=True agar aman)
target_abfss = f"{temp_dir_abfss}/ForExportNewApi.csv"
mssparkutils.fs.cp(f"file:{selected_csv}", target_abfss, recurse=True)

# 4. Cek batas waktu terakhir di Silver untuk filter incremental
silver_root = f"abfss://{container}@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/tomtom"

df_raw_csv = (
    spark.read.option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "true")
    .csv(target_abfss)
)

# Pastikan format timestamp sebelum dibandingkan
df_raw_csv = df_raw_csv.withColumn(
    "UpdateTimeUTC_ts", F.to_timestamp("UpdateTimeUTC", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
)

try:
  df_existing_silver = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_root)
  last_watermark = df_existing_silver.agg(
      F.max("UpdateTimeUTC")
  ).collect()[0][0]
except Exception:
  last_watermark = None

if last_watermark is not None:
  print(f"Mode Incremental: menarik data setelah {last_watermark}")
  df_filtered = df_raw_csv.filter(
      F.col("UpdateTimeUTC_ts") > F.lit(last_watermark)
  )
  write_mode = "append"
else:
  print("Mode Initial Load: menarik seluruh data historis")
  df_filtered = df_raw_csv
  write_mode = "overwrite"

df_to_bronze = (
    df_filtered.drop("UpdateTimeUTC_ts")
    .withColumn(
        "year", F.year(F.to_timestamp("LocalDateTime", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"))
    )
    .withColumn(
        "month", F.month(F.to_timestamp("LocalDateTime", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"))
    )
)

if df_to_bronze.head(1):
  (
      df_to_bronze.write.format("parquet")
      .mode(write_mode)
      .partitionBy("year", "month")
      .save(bronze_root)
  )
  print("Data baru berhasil ditambahkan ke Bronze")
else:
  print("Tidak ada data baru dari Kaggle minggu ini.")

# 5. Bersihkan seluruh file sementara di lokal & ADLS
shutil.rmtree(local_download_dir, ignore_errors=True)
shutil.rmtree(local_kaggle_dir, ignore_errors=True)
mssparkutils.fs.rm(temp_dir_abfss, recurse=True)

print("Download Kaggle API, ekstraksi, dan partisi Bronze Parquet selesai")

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import types as T
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

# Sumber Parquet terpartisi
bronze_root = (f"abfss://{container}@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/tomtom_partitioned")

# Output Delta
silver_root = (f"abfss://{container}@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/tomtom")
gold_root = (f"abfss://{container}@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/tomtom")

# Zona waktu: UTC untuk timestamp sumber jika timestamp memang UTC.
spark.conf.set("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC")

print("Bronze:", bronze_root)
print("Silver:", silver_root)
print("Gold:", gold_root)
print("Spark version:", spark.version)
### Baca seluruh batch Parquet dari root Bronze

from datetime import datetime, timezone

# Ambil tahun & bulan sekarang + bulan lalu (antisipasi pergantian bulan di tengah minggu)
now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
current_year = now_utc.year
current_month = now_utc.month
prev_month = 12 if current_month == 1 else current_month - 1
prev_year = current_year - 1 if current_month == 1 else current_year

df_bronze_all = spark.read.format("parquet").load(bronze_root)

# Filter hanya partisi 2 bulan terakhir untuk diproses ke Silver
df_bronze = df_bronze_all.filter(
    ((F.col("year") == current_year) & (F.col("month") == current_month))
    | ((F.col("year") == prev_year) & (F.col("month") == prev_month))

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

print("Jumlah baris:", df_bronze.count())
print("Jumlah kolom:", len(df_bronze.columns))

# Nilai null per kolom
null_profile = df_bronze.select([
    F.count(F.when(F.col(c).isNull(), 1)).alias(c)
    for c in df_bronze.columns
])
display(null_profile)

# Pastikan partisi year dan month berhasil terbaca
for required_partition in ["year", "month"]:
    if required_partition not in df_bronze.columns:
        print(f"PERHATIAN: kolom partisi {required_partition} tidak ditemukan.")
    else:
        print(f"Distinct {required_partition}:")
        display(df_bronze.select(required_partition).distinct().orderBy(required_partition))
### Konfigurasi pemetaan kolom

# Identitas wilayah
COL_COUNTRY = "Country"
COL_CITY = "City"

# Kolom waktu
COL_TIMESTAMP = "UpdateTimeUTC"
COL_LOCAL_TIMESTAMP = "LocalDateTime"
COL_LOCAL_TIMESTAMP_WEEK_AGO = "LocalDateTimeWeekAgo"

# Kolom lalu lintas
COL_JAMS_DELAY = "JamsDelay"
COL_TRAFFIC_INDEX_LIVE = "TrafficIndexLive"
COL_JAMS_COUNT = "JamsCount"
COL_TRAFFIC_INDEX_WEEK_AGO = "TrafficIndexWeekAgo"

# Kolom waktu tempuh
COL_TRAVEL_TIME_LIVE = "TravelTimeLivePer10KmsMins"
COL_TRAVEL_TIME_HISTORIC = "TravelTimeHistoricPer10KmsMins"
COL_MINS_DELAY = "MinsDelay"

# Kolom tambahan
COL_WEEK_AGO = "WeekAgo"

# Kolom partisi
COL_YEAR = "year"
COL_MONTH = "month"

# Tidak tersedia pada dataset ini
COL_CURRENT_SPEED = None
COL_FREE_FLOW_SPEED = None
COL_CURRENT_TRAVEL_TIME = None
COL_FREE_FLOW_TRAVEL_TIME = None
COL_CONFIDENCE = None
COL_ROAD_CLOSURE = None
COL_FRC = None
COL_SEGMENT_ID = None
COL_COORDINATES = None

# Validasi kolom wajib
def require_column(df, col_name, logical_name):
    if col_name is None or col_name not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Kolom {logical_name} tidak ditemukan: {col_name}"
        )

require_column(df_bronze, COL_COUNTRY, "Country")
require_column(df_bronze, COL_CITY, "City")
require_column(df_bronze, COL_TIMESTAMP, "UpdateTimeUTC")
require_column(df_bronze, COL_JAMS_COUNT, "JamsCount")

print("Pemetaan kolom berhasil.")
### Standarisasi nama, tipe data, dan nilai kategori

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# 1. Standarisasi Country dan City
df_work = (
    df_bronze
    .withColumn(
        "Country",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col(COL_COUNTRY).cast("string")))
    )
    .withColumn(
        "City",
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col(COL_CITY).cast("string")))
    )
)

# 2. Konversi kolom timestamp
TIMESTAMP_COLUMNS = [
    "UpdateTimeUTC",
    "LocalDateTime",
    "LocalDateTimeWeekAgo"
]

for c in TIMESTAMP_COLUMNS:
    if c in df_work.columns:
        df_work = df_work.withColumn(
            c,
            F.to_timestamp(
                F.col(c),
                "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
            )
        )

# 3. Konversi JamsCount menjadi integer
df_work = df_work.withColumn(
    "JamsCount",
    F.col("JamsCount").cast("int")
)

# 4. Konversi kolom numerik menjadi double
DOUBLE_COLUMNS = [
    "JamsDelay",
    "TrafficIndexLive",
    "TrafficIndexWeekAgo",
    "TravelTimeLivePer10KmsMins",
    "TravelTimeHistoricPer10KmsMins",
    "MinsDelay"
]

for c in DOUBLE_COLUMNS:
    if c in df_work.columns:
        df_work = df_work.withColumn(
            c,
            F.col(c).cast("double")
        )

# 5. Pastikan kolom partisi bertipe integer
df_work = (
    df_work
    .withColumn("year", F.col("year").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("month", F.col("month").cast("int"))
)

# 6. Tambahkan waktu preprocessing
df_work = df_work.withColumn(
    "processed_at_utc",
    F.current_timestamp()
)

# 7. Periksa hasil
display(df_work.limit(10))
df_work.printSchema()

# Periksa apakah ada nilai yang gagal dikonversi
display(
    df_work.select(
        F.count("*").alias("total_rows"),

        F.count(
            F.when(F.col("UpdateTimeUTC").isNull(), 1)
        ).alias("null_UpdateTimeUTC"),

        F.count(
            F.when(F.col("LocalDateTime").isNull(), 1)
        ).alias("null_LocalDateTime"),

        F.count(
            F.when(F.col("LocalDateTimeWeekAgo").isNull(), 1)
        ).alias("null_LocalDateTimeWeekAgo"),

        F.count(
            F.when(F.col("JamsCount").isNull(), 1)
        ).alias("null_JamsCount")
    )
### Validasi dan pembersihan data

# Validasi kolom wajib
required_columns = [
    "Country",
    "City",
    "UpdateTimeUTC",
    "LocalDateTime"
]

for c in required_columns:
    if c not in df_work.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Kolom wajib tidak ditemukan: {c}")

# Periksa nilai kosong sebelum filtering
print("Jumlah baris awal:", df_work.count())

display(
    df_work.select([
        F.count(
            F.when(F.col(c).isNull(), 1)
        ).alias(c)
        for c in required_columns
    ])
)

# Hapus baris yang tidak memiliki identitas wilayah dan waktu
df_clean = df_work.filter(
    F.col("Country").isNotNull() &
    (F.col("Country") != "") &
    F.col("City").isNotNull() &
    (F.col("City") != "") &
    F.col("UpdateTimeUTC").isNotNull() &
    F.col("LocalDateTime").isNotNull()
)

# JamsCount tidak boleh negatif
df_clean = df_clean.filter(
    F.col("JamsCount").isNull() |
    (F.col("JamsCount") >= 0)
)

print("Jumlah baris setelah validasi:", df_clean.count())

display(df_clean.limit(10))

# Audit nilai null setelah konversi tipe data
cols_to_audit = [c for c in [
    "UpdateTimeUTC", "LocalDateTime", "LocalDateTimeWeekAgo", "JamsCount"
] if c in df_clean.columns]
if cols_to_audit:
    display(df_clean.select([
        F.count(F.when(F.col(c).isNull(), 1)).alias(c)
        for c in cols_to_audit
### Deduplikasi

DEDUP_KEY_COLUMNS = [
    "Country",
    "City",
    "UpdateTimeUTC"
]

# Periksa jumlah duplikasi
duplicate_check = (
    df_clean
    .groupBy(*DEDUP_KEY_COLUMNS)
    .count()
    .filter(F.col("count") > 1)
)

display(duplicate_check.limit(20))

# Hapus duplikasi berdasarkan kunci observasi
df_clean = df_clean.dropDuplicates(DEDUP_KEY_COLUMNS)

print("Jumlah baris setelah deduplikasi:", df_clean.count())
### Buat indikator tambahan

df_silver = (
    df_clean
    .withColumn(
        "traffic_index_change_vs_week_ago",
        F.col("TrafficIndexLive") -
        F.col("TrafficIndexWeekAgo")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "travel_time_change_vs_historic",
        F.col("TravelTimeLivePer10KmsMins") -
        F.col("TravelTimeHistoricPer10KmsMins")
    )
)

display(df_silver.limit(10))
### Pemeriksaan cakupan periode

# Pemeriksaan jumlah data per bulan
period_check = (
    df_silver
    .groupBy("year", "month")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("total_records"),
        F.countDistinct("City").alias("total_cities"),
        F.countDistinct("Country").alias("total_countries")
    )
    .orderBy("year", "month")
)

display(period_check)


# Pemeriksaan rentang waktu observasi
df_silver.select(
    F.min("UpdateTimeUTC").alias("first_update_utc"),
    F.max("UpdateTimeUTC").alias("last_update_utc"),
    F.min("LocalDateTime").alias("first_local_time"),
    F.max("LocalDateTime").alias("last_local_time")
).show(truncate=False)
### simpan silver sebagai delta, dipartisi per negara

from delta.tables import DeltaTable

if DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, silver_root):
  silver_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, silver_root)
  (
      silver_table.alias("target")
      .merge(
          df_silver.alias("source"),
          "target.Country = source.Country AND target.City = source.City AND"
          " target.UpdateTimeUTC = source.UpdateTimeUTC",
      )
      .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
      .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
      .execute()
  )
  print("Incremental MERGE ke Silver selesai")
else:
  (
      df_silver.write.format("delta")
      .mode("overwrite")
      .partitionBy("Country")
      .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
      .save(silver_root)
  )
  print("Initial Silver Delta tersimpan")
### optimize dan z-order silver

df_silver_final = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_root)

print("Total records Silver:", df_silver_final.count())
df_silver_final.printSchema()
### validasi hasil silver

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# Membaca kembali data Silver dari ADLS
df_silver_check = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_root)

# 1. Memeriksa jumlah data
print("Total records Silver:", df_silver_check.count())

# 2. Memeriksa skema
df_silver_check.printSchema()

# 3. Memeriksa nilai null pada kolom penting
display(
    df_silver_check.select(
        *[
            F.count(F.when(F.col(c).isNull(), 1)).alias(c)
            for c in [
                "Country", "City", "UpdateTimeUTC",
                "LocalDateTime", "JamsCount"
            ]
        ]
    )
)

# 4. Memeriksa rentang waktu
df_silver_check.select(
    F.min("UpdateTimeUTC").alias("first_update"),
    F.max("UpdateTimeUTC").alias("last_update")
).show(truncate=False)

# 5. Memeriksa jumlah data per negara
display(
    df_silver_check.groupBy("Country")
    .count()
    .orderBy("Country")
### buat gold (agregasi lalu lintas per kota dan jam/bulan)

# Baca seluruh tabel Silver dari ADLS agar histori Gold tetap lengkap dari 2025
df_silver_full = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_root)

gold_source = df_silver_full.withColumn(
    "observation_hour", F.date_trunc("hour", F.col("LocalDateTime"))
)

gold_traffic_city = (
    gold_source
    .groupBy(
        "Country",
        "City",
        "observation_hour"
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("TrafficIndexLive").alias("avg_traffic_index"),

        F.avg("TrafficIndexWeekAgo").alias(
            "avg_traffic_index_week_ago"
        ),

        F.avg("JamsCount").alias("avg_jams_count"),

        F.avg("JamsDelay").alias("avg_jams_delay"),

        F.avg("MinsDelay").alias("avg_mins_delay"),

        F.avg("TravelTimeLivePer10KmsMins").alias(
            "avg_travel_time_live"
        ),

        F.avg("TravelTimeHistoricPer10KmsMins").alias(
            "avg_travel_time_historic"
        ),

        F.avg("traffic_index_change_vs_week_ago").alias(
            "avg_traffic_index_change"
        ),

        F.count("*").alias("total_observations")
    )
    .orderBy("Country", "City", "observation_hour")
)

display(gold_traffic_city.limit(20))
### Gold features untuk ML

window_spec = (
    Window
    .partitionBy("Country", "City")
    .orderBy("observation_hour")
)

gold_traffic_features = (
    gold_traffic_city
    .withColumn(
        "previous_traffic_index",
        F.lag("avg_traffic_index", 1).over(window_spec)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "previous_jams_count",
        F.lag("avg_jams_count", 1).over(window_spec)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "previous_mins_delay",
        F.lag("avg_mins_delay", 1).over(window_spec)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "traffic_index_next_observation",
        F.lead("avg_traffic_index", 1).over(window_spec)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "hour_of_day",
        F.hour("observation_hour")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "day_of_week",
        F.dayofweek("observation_hour")
    )
)

display(gold_traffic_features.limit(20))
### simpan gold sebagai delta

gold_city_path = f"{gold_root}/traffic_city"

(
    gold_traffic_city.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
    .partitionBy("Country")
    .save(gold_city_path)
)

gold_features_path = f"{gold_root}/traffic_features"

(
    gold_traffic_features.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
    .partitionBy("Country")
    .save(gold_features_path)
)

print("Gold berhasil disimpan.")
### optimize dan z-order gold
### validasi hasil gold

gold_city_path = f"{gold_root}/traffic_city"

df_gold_city_check = spark.read.format("delta").load(gold_city_path)

print("Total records Gold Traffic City:", df_gold_city_check.count())

df_gold_city_check.printSchema()

display(df_gold_city_check.limit(10))

display(
    df_gold_city_check.groupBy("Country")
    .count()
    .orderBy("Country")

gold_features_path = f"{gold_root}/traffic_features"

df_gold_features_check = spark.read.format("delta").load(gold_features_path)

print("Total records Gold Traffic Features:", df_gold_features_check.count())

df_gold_features_check.printSchema()

display(df_gold_features_check.limit(10))

# Memeriksa ketersediaan fitur dan target prediksi
display(
    df_gold_features_check.select(
        F.count("*").alias("total_records"),
        F.count("previous_traffic_index").alias("available_previous_index"),
        F.count("traffic_index_next_observation").alias("available_target")
    )
### stop session
mssparkutils.session.stop()
